description: Dext ABI v3 (C++): extend driver/AVBShared.h from ABI v2 to v3 (design §3.1) and implement the shared-memory RX rings, classifier, ownership, StepClock, counters, stream filter, TX token bucket, clock generation/step tagging and client entitlement check in the AVBI210Driver dext (§3.2-§3.7); adapt the BCM dext to kAvbSelBaseCount; host tests for every new pure helper. First FEAT: every Rust FEAT mirrors the literals asserted here. No new register writes.
steps: driver/AVBShared.h: add #include <stddef.h>; AVB_ABI_VERSION 3u; selectors 10-14, kAvbSelCount 15, kAvbSelBaseCount 10 (comment: 32..47 reserved for talker); AvbMemType; AVB_FLAG_RINGS_ATTACHED/OWNED; all AVB_SHM_*/AVB_RX_*/AVB_MAX_STREAMS/AVB_STEP_*/AVB_TX_* constants; AvbRxClass, AVB_RX_CLASS_COUNT, AVB_RXF_* (TS_HW=1, VLAN_FRAME=2, VLAN_DESC=4, TS_STEP_AMBIG=8), AVB_STEP_SETTLE_NS; structs AvbRxSlot, AvbCounterIndex (incl. kAvbCtrRxOversize=33), AvbCounters, AvbShmHeader (clock_gen @896), AvbShmConsumer, AvbStreamFilterEntry/AvbStreamFilter; every static_assert from §3.1 verbatim. Replace the '16..31 reserved' comment. Existing structs unchanged (60/24/152/3656).

driver/AVBBcmDriver/AVBBcmUserClient.cpp: the three kAvbSelCount uses (lines 54, 66, 131) -> kAvbSelBaseCount; static_assert becomes sizeof(kDispatch)/sizeof(kDispatch[0]) == kAvbSelBaseCount. No other BCM change (DP-12).

driver/AVBI210Driver/I210Regs.h: add read-only constants kCrcerrs 0x04000, kMpc 0x04010, kRnbc 0x040A0, kRqdpc0 0x0C030 with 333016 citation + '(verify)' comments, RX status VP bit 3 constant. I210Logic.hpp: isReadableRegOffsetI210 gains case kRqdpc0 -> false; add pure helpers classifyRx(frame, flen, ourMac, filter, vp, vlanField) -> verdict (§3.4 rules 1-6 incl. drop reasons), isAvdeccDest, rxVlanFlags, rxFrameBounds(len, tsip) -> {Ok(flen)|ShortTs|Oversize}, rxHarvestStep(bool*, eop) -> {Discard|NonEop|Frame}, ringFree(head, tail, slots) with invalid-tail detection, stepTarget, RxStepAmbig + rxStepArm/rxStepAmbiguous, tokenBucketTake, stats accumulation helper, producerRunning(attached, stage, fault), stream-filter validation (count<=16, multicast bit, 1<=vid<=4094).

driver/AVBI210Driver/AVBI210Driver.cpp: kRxRingSize 2048; RX buffers as kRxBufChunks=16 x kRxBufChunkBytes=256 KiB (IV::rxBufs[16], descriptor i -> chunk i/128 offset (i%128)*2048, dmaFreeAll frees all); kTimerPeriodNs 500 us leeway 50 us; kTxTsTimeoutNs 20 ms. Add setStage()/setFlags() and replace every direct v->stage / v->flags write (lines ~346, 452, 495, 497, 770, 771, 807); setFault mirrors fault + clears producer_running into the header; setClock() helper (line ~290) increments ivars->clockGen, release-stores hdr->clock_gen, calls rxStepArm (settleTicks computed at Start from the timebase).

AVBI210Driver.cpp harvest: ring-mode TimerFired per the §3.4 pseudocode (last_tick_mach first, ambig once per tick, tail validation + kAvbCtrConsumerIndexInvalid, rxHarvestStep, RXE, TSIP short guard, oversize guard BEFORE classify/memcpy, classifyRx, drop-newest overrun, slot header fill incl. clock_gen/flags, head release-store after loop, RDT write once, relaxed counter stores); STATUS link poll every 10 ticks with LinkUp/Down counters; MPC/RNBC/RQDPC0/CRCERRS accumulate every 200 ticks; legacy harvestRx keeps the software ring when no rings are attached and uses rxHarvestStep for !EOP. Counters for TX (frames, rate limited, ts requested/ok/timeout/busy/stale latch).

AVBI210Driver.cpp new selectors in HandleUserMethod(client, selector, args): StepClock (|delta|<=1 s, result in [0,2^32 s), returns before/after/mach_mid), GetCounters (512 B struct out), SetStreamFilter (strict owner, rings attached, validated), RingAttach (flags==0, stage>=1, ownership, idempotent for same owner, RingsUsed() -> kIOReturnNotPermitted, IOBufferMemoryDescriptor::Create rxMem AVB_RX_MEM_SIZE + consumerMem 16 KiB, zero, header constants, generation++, setFlags), RingDetach (§3.6 order). Owner-only enforcement for selectors 2,3,4,5,6,7,9,10 when an owner exists (kIOReturnExclusiveAccess); PollRx returns kIOReturnNotReady while rings attached; InitDatapath/ShutdownDatapath never change ownership; ShutdownDatapath with rings keeps them mapped (producer_running=0). TX token bucket (1000/s, burst 64) -> kIOReturnNoResources.

AVBI210Driver.iig: HandleUserMethod gains AVBI210UserClient* client first param; add CopyRingMemory(client, type, options, memory) LOCALONLY and ClientGone(client) LOCALONLY (§3.3 order: producer off, shutdownDatapath, clear filter/TX ts/bucket + setFlags clear, release rxMem/consumerMem, owner=nullptr; non-owner only logs 'AVBI210: uc: closed (not owner)').

AVBI210UserClient.iig/.cpp: kDispatch[kAvbSelCount] with the §3.2 rows for 10-14 and a sizeof-based static_assert == kAvbSelCount; guard selector >= kAvbSelCount; Forward passes this; override CopyClientMemoryForType forwarding to CopyRingMemory on the driver queue (DispatchSync_f pattern); Stop calls ClientGone(this) on the driver queue before super::Stop; MarkRingsUsed()/RingsUsed() LOCALONLY with ivar ringsUsed; Start checks CopyClientEntitlements contains com.apple.developer.driverkit.userclient-access array with 'com.avbaudio.installer.i210' else kIOReturnNotPermitted + log 'AVBI210: uc: client lacks userclient-access entitlement'. Keep allow-any-userclient-access in the dext entitlements.

driver/tests/i210logic_tests.cpp and tg3logic_tests.cpp: static_assert(AVB_ABI_VERSION == 3); tg3 asserts kAvbSelBaseCount == 10; i210 adds every §3.1 offsetof/sizeof literal and every §3.7 host test (classifyRx all rules/drops, rxFrameBounds cases 0/15/16/2000/2048 TSIP and 1984/1985 non-TSIP, rxHarvestStep sequences + counter deltas, rxVlanFlags 4 combos, ringFree incl. 2^64 wrap and invalid tails, stepTarget, rxStepArm/rxStepAmbiguous incl. 5 ms delayed tick and double step, tokenBucketTake, stats accumulation, filter rejection unicast/VID 0/4095, isAvdeccDest boundary table, CHECK(!isReadableRegOffsetI210(0xC030)), producerRunning truth table).

scripts/package.sh: switch both xcodebuild invocations to -scheme "$proj" -derivedDataPath "$SCRATCH/DerivedData" (xcodebuild rejects -derivedDataPath with -target), keeping SYMROOT/OBJROOT so DEXT_BUILT is unchanged. (Daemon embedding is FEAT-005.)

Append a 'FEAT-001' section to /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tasks/phase1a-impl-verification.md with the commands run and results; commit 'feat(dext): ABI v3 shared RX rings, classifier, ownership, StepClock (phase1a FEAT-001)'.
acceptance_criteria: make -C /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/driver/tests test passes with all new i210 checks and the tg3 suite (ABI 3, kAvbSelBaseCount 10)
Both dexts build with xcodebuild (-scheme, -derivedDataPath under .agents/tmp) with 0 warnings
scripts/package.sh --adhoc completes ('packaged:' line, dext archs arm64e) - Rust side may still report ABI 2 in avb-probe until FEAT-002; package.sh must still succeed

No new register write sequences: the only new register accesses are reads of CRCERRS/MPC/RNBC/RQDPC(0); every SYSTIM write goes through setClock(); every stage/flags write goes through setStage/setFlags
Every harvest memcpy is preceded by the TSIP-short and oversize guards

findings: ABI literals (driver/AVBShared.h, asserted in driver/tests/i210logic_tests.cpp; Rust mirror must match): AVB_ABI_VERSION 3; selectors StepClock 10, GetCounters 11, SetStreamFilter 12, RingAttach 13, RingDetach 14, kAvbSelCount 15, kAvbSelBaseCount 10; kAvbMemRx 1 (read-only map), kAvbMemConsumer 2 (read-write); AVB_FLAG_RINGS_ATTACHED 0x20, AVB_FLAG_OWNED 0x40; AVB_SHM_MAGIC 0x33425641; header 16384, slot 2048, slot hdr 64, data max 1984, ctl slots 512 @16384, audio slots 8192 @1064960, AVB_RX_MEM_SIZE 17842176, AVB_CONSUMER_MEM_SIZE 16384; AVB_MAX_STREAMS 16; AVB_STEP_CLOCK_MAX_NS 1e9; TX bucket 1000/s burst 64; AvbRxClass None0 Gptp1 Msrp2 Mvrp3 Avdecc4 Maap5 Stream6, AVB_RX_CLASS_COUNT 7; AVB_RXF_TS_HW 1, VLAN_FRAME 2, VLAN_DESC 4, TS_STEP_AMBIG 8; AVB_STEP_SETTLE_NS 1000000. AvbRxSlot offsets: hw_ts_ns 0, harvest_mach 8, index 16, status_error 24, len 28, vlan_tci 30, flags 32, cls 34, pad0 35, desc_len 36, clock_gen 40, pad1 44, data 64. AvbShmHeader offsets: magic 0, abi_version 4, header_size 8, slot_size 12, ctl_slots 16, audio_slots 20, ctl_offset 24, audio_offset 28, total_size 32, generation 36, stage 40, fault 44, flags 48, producer_running 52, last_tick_mach 56, mac 64, pad0 70, ctl_head 128, pad1 136, audio_head 256, pad2 264, counters 384, clock_gen 896, reserved 900, size 1024. AvbShmConsumer: ctl_tail 0, audio_tail 128, size 256. AvbStreamFilterEntry 8 B (vid @6); AvbStreamFilter 136 B (count 0, pad 4, e 8). Counter indices 0..33 exactly as design §3.1 (kAvbCtrRxOversize 33, kAvbCtrCount 64), class counter index == cls. Selector behavior: StepClock in delta (i64 as u64) out [before_ns, after_ns, mach_mid]; |delta|>1e9 or result outside [0,2^32 s) -> kIOReturnBadArgument. GetCounters works without rings (512 B struct out). SetStreamFilter needs structIn of exactly 136 B, rings attached (else NotReady) and caller == owner (else ExclusiveAccess); validation count<=16, dest_mac[0]&1, 1<=vid<=4094. RingAttach in flags (must be 0) out [generation, 17842176, 16384]; stage<1 -> NotReady; other owner -> ExclusiveAccess (0xe00002c5); same owner while attached -> same values; second attach on the same connection after detach -> NotPermitted (0xe00002e2); alloc failure -> NoMemory. RingDetach: not attached -> NotReady, non-owner -> ExclusiveAccess. Owner-only selectors 2,3,4,5,6,7,9,10 return ExclusiveAccess to non-owners only while an owner exists. PollRx -> NotReady while rings attached. SendFrame -> kIOReturnNoResources (0xe00002be) when the token bucket is empty (counts TxRateLimited). Daemon must check hdr.generation == RingAttach scalarOut[0]. Dext internals: helpers in I210Logic.hpp namespace i210logic: classifyRx(frame,len,ourMac,filter,vp,vlanField)->RxVerdict {Gptp..Stream = AvbRxClass values, DropOther 0x80, DropUnboundStream 0x81, DropUntaggedStream 0x82}, rxDelivered, rxVerdictCounter, isAvdeccDest(dst,ourMac), rxVlanFlags(vp,frame,len), rxFrameBounds(pktLen,tsip)->{RxBoundsKind Ok|ShortTs|Oversize, flen}, rxHarvestStep(bool*,eop)->RxStep{Discard,NonEop,Frame}, ringFree(head,tail,slots)->RingSpace{valid,free}, producerRunning(attached,stage,fault), stepTarget(s0,delta,elapsedNs)->StepResult{ok,target}, RxStepAmbig/rxStepArm/rxStepAmbiguous, TokenBucket/tokenBucketTake(b,nowNs), HwStatsRead/statsAccumulate(c,&rqdpcLast,r), streamFilterValid(f). AVTP control/MAAP subtypes to non-AVDECC destinations -> DropOther. Counters are published to hdr->counters every tick (relaxed); heads release-stored after each harvest; last_tick_mach written first every 500 us tick. RX counters RxFrames/RxErrors/RxNonEop/RxOversize also count in legacy (PollRx) mode; classification and ring counters only in ring mode. Deviations recorded in phase1a-impl-verification.md: RQDPC(0) is RW and wrapping per 333016 rev 3.7 §8.10.10 (not clear-on-read), so it is accumulated as a mod-2^32 delta; datasheet sections are CRCERRS §8.18.1, MPC §8.18.5, RNBC §8.18.34, RQDPC §8.10.10. The class-counter static_assert uses a uint32_t cast (C++20 -Wdeprecated-enum-enum-conversion). Pending for later FEATs: avb-probe still asserts ABI 2 and fails GetInfo against this dext until FEAT-002 bumps its mirror (do not install this dext for probe use before FEAT-002). The new UserClient Start rejects clients without com.apple.developer.driverkit.userclient-access containing com.avbaudio.installer.i210 (kIOReturnNotPermitted, log 'AVBI210: uc: client lacks userclient-access entitlement'); probe.entitlements already has it, and FEAT-005 must give avb-daemon the same entitlement. package.sh now builds with -scheme/-derivedDataPath $SCRATCH/DerivedData; FEAT-005 adds daemon embedding.
